हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A widowed gold magnate enters a contract marriage with a man she believes is a broken ex-convict to protect her daughter and failing empire. When powerful gold syndicates threaten her business and child, a hidden truth emerges her husband is a feared, erased force from the past. As their marriage turns real, he unleashes his true identity to protect his family and reclaim power.
